summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. furnished a Form 6-K with an English translation of its September 22, 2026 letter to the Bolsa de Comercio de Buenos Aires and the CNV, disclosing approval of an additional investment of up to USD 4,000,000 in cash or in kind in Golden Juniors Segregated Portfolio, an investment fund managed by a company directly controlled by Chairman Eduardo Sergio Elsztain. The Audit Committee, consulted under CNV rules and Capital Markets Law No. 26,831, raised no objections. This related-party liquidity diversification into precious metals and mining is not a special situation; watch governance and disclosure of related-party terms.
